issue_request: FHIR-12445 was Published as Persuasive for DSTU2. It asked that the hidden capability to bind string and uri datatype values to ValueSets be mentioned or referenced from the datatype description, with Jira comments also identifying ElementDefinition binding definitions and the terminology page.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 11209, represented in git as 2c193d421ae18ee2a394e0fede71a70984fe6f03. That commit added a datatypes-page note, expanded terminology-page references, and updated source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml so ElementDefinition.binding mentioned string and uri.
additional_context: Later same-family issue FHIR-13657 made string and uri datatype-row binding links more visible and restored current guidance about duplicate code strings across systems. Later FHIR-22670 removed the old dedicated terminologies.html#strings section, so the current source intentionally uses active terminology table anchors and general binding-strength guidance instead of the original bottom-of-page text. FHIR-35891 also reinforces that string and uri are among the bindable datatypes when an element allows multiple types.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-12445: source/datatypes.html has direct string and uri ValueSet binding notes, source/terminologies.html lists string and uri as datatypes that can be bound to value sets and explains how literal values are matched, and the ElementDefinition spreadsheet source still allows binding on string and uri elements.
